articles.title: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
articles.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, but their generalization remains constrained by the diversity and coverage of action-labeled robot demonstrations. articles.summary: The Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) measures baryon acoustic oscillations (BAO) in the Lyman-$α$ (Lyman-alpha) forest and provides a robust probe of the expansion history in the matter-dominated era. Yet, non-linear structure formation broadens and shifts the BAO peak. articles.title: Can Discrete Tokens Serve as Semantically Lossless Representations of Visual Signals?
articles.summary: Discrete visual tokens represent vision in a discrete form analogous to language, offering a native interface for multimodal modeling under a shared next-token prediction objective. articles.title: The Spatially-Resolved Recent Star Formation History of the M81 Disk
articles.summary: The nearby M81 galaxy---a tidally interacting $L^*$ spiral disk---offers a unique perspective on the interplay of secular and external processes in shaping galaxy properties. articles.summary: Test-time adaptation helps a deployed model respond to changing inputs, but the same intervention can rescue one batch and damage the next. Updating normalization statistics, for example, can improve corrupted images yet fail when a batch contains mostly one class. articles.summary: We introduce Heads of Security (HoS), a prompt injection defense that enforces instruction-data separation via a small set of learned per-head attention gates. articles.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in multi-turn agentic workloads that require sustained interaction with complex environments. articles.summary: Scientific discovery often begins with an unexpected observation that prompts a new research question. articles.summary: We explore how to build performant large language model (LLM) tool-use agents that complete complex, multi-step tasks. Specifically, we study how data composition in synthetically generated tool-use environments affects the training of such agents. articles.title: Metacognitive Decoding: Efficient Inference for Diffusion Language Agents
articles.summary: Diffusion language models offer a promising path to efficient agents through parallel token generation. However, efficient interaction requires adapting both where computation is spent and how much text is generated. articles.summary: Recent advances in generative audio models facilitate increasingly flexible and selective editing of linguistic content and paralinguistic, extralinguistic, and other attributes. articles.title: Know, then Draw: A New Learning Paradigm for Visual Generation
articles.summary: Visual generation requires both high-level semantic knowledge and fine-grained pixel details. articles.summary: Agile robots require spatiotemporal intelligence to interpret scenes, reason about interactions, and anticipate future events. articles.summary: Chain-of-thought reasoning has substantially advanced video understanding in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). articles.summary: As executable environments for language agents scale, generating and verifying their rollouts becomes increasingly expensive. articles.summary: The behavior of biomolecular complexes is governed by chemically specific interactions and often involves rare events that atomistic molecular dynamics struggle to capture within accessible timescales. articles.summary: Models of the dark sector in which the dark matter participates in nontrivial interactions can create detectable signatures in cosmological observables, providing non-terrestrial means of probing the nature of dark matter. articles.summary: Developing on-device image models requires considering practical user needs, task types and device resource constraints. articles.summary: World models are widely proposed as core components for enabling agents to reason over long temporal and spatial horizons.
